decisions.reason: The construction site dumper sits close to the firm's core vehicle competence, but it was only mentioned on the website, not given its own page, which suggests a peripheral product at some risk after the mining vehicle lines were already dropped.
The inclined furniture lift is a product line presented on its own page, serves steady demand from movers and craftsmen, and fits the firm's lifting know-how and service network.
The inclined building material lift line complements the furniture lifts and benefits from strong construction and roofing demand around 2022, so keeping it makes sense.
The truck-mounted furniture lift extends the lift family into a higher-value niche with shared components, so it is likely retained despite being a single model.
